concerns.text: T010 narrows the dbSNP input to 'chromosomes 21 and 22' while FR-001 mandates common human SNPs genome-wide (MAF > 1%). The narrowing is acknowledged only as a 'representativeness limitation' in T007's report; no spec amendment authorizes the subset. Either amend FR-001 to sanction the chr21/22 scope or add a task that justifies/extends the scope; a task cannot silently relax an FR.

T021 scores only 'a small set (≥20) of high-confidence JASPAR motifs', but FR-002/FR-003 require ΔScore 'for every valid SNP-TF pair' and US-1 scenario 2 requires ALL human JASPAR matrices parsed and ready. No Phase-2 task expands scoring to the full human motif set before T024/T025 consume `scores.parquet`; the statistical analysis would run on the thin checkpoint subset. Add a task (or extend T021) that scores the full high-confidence human motif domain.

T025 requires results 'conforming to contracts/enrichment_result_schema.schema.yaml, including enrichment ratios of high-impact SNPs in GWAS loci vs expected overlap (SC-003)', but that schema (additionalProperties: false) has no observed_overlap/expected_overlap/enrichment_ratio fields — those live only in the conflicting enrichment_schema/result_schema files. The task is internally contradictory: it cannot both conform to the named schema and record SC-003 evidence. Resolve which schema is authoritative.

US-3 acceptance scenario 3 (a known disease-associated TF, e.g. TCF7L2/T2D, must return a significant corrected p-value, validating true-positive detection) has no implementing or verifying task. T024's synthetic unit test covers only generic enrichment. This acceptance criterion is dropped from the task list.

Tasks cite 'specs/001-gene-regulation/contracts/...' but the contract files live under specs/001-systematic-assessment-of-non-coding-vari/contracts/. The validation steps point at a nonexistent path; fix the path references.

T013b's note restricts the GC-matched control set to 'baseline/sensitivity reporting only, not the primary KS test'. FR-005 permits comparison against 'SNPs outside GWAS loci (or the matched control set)'. The narrowing is defensible (disjunctive) but is recorded only in a task note; reconcile it in spec/plan so the constraint change is not task-level drift.

US-1 scenario 3 requires exclusion of non-human-species variants; T014 filters only MAF and ACGT alleles. Likely benign for the human-only dbSNP path, but the acceptance criterion is unverifiable as specified — either note the human-only source satisfies it or add the filter.
